title: Custom launch entries
description: Add programs, documents or folders to app search.
name: Search name
pathHelp: Choose a replacement target to keep this entry’s name and identity.
argumentsHelp: Each string is one argument, preserving spaces. For example: ["--profile", "My Profile"]. Leave [] for no arguments.
directoryHelp: Authorize a working directory with Choose. Leave empty to use the program’s own directory.
shortcutHelp: Shortcuts retain their original arguments, working directory, and Windows Shell behavior.
invalidArguments: Arguments for {{name}} must be a JSON array of strings.
dropHelp: You can also choose a target below. Each folder becomes a single launch entry.
legacySupport: This application plugin supports programs and shortcuts. Update it to add documents and folders.
documentHelp: Documents open in their default application. Arguments and working directories apply to programs.
folderHelp: Open the folder itself as a single launch entry.
unsupportedKind: This application plugin does not support {{kind}} entries. Update it or choose a supported type.
dropUnavailable: No usable local path was received. Use the file or folder chooser instead.
tooMany: You can add up to 200 entries.
